decision: Bootstrap the guided setup from a licensed bundled snapshot of qdm12/gluetun-servers and allow authenticated refreshes from that official repository. Do not start a fake or partially configured production Gluetun container to discover provider values.
rationale: Gluetun startup validates provider filters before a VPN connection and can exit when a value is invalid. Reading the official server dataset directly gives Tuniku real provider and protocol choices before Gluetun exists, avoids fake credentials, and keeps Tuniku available throughout first setup. A bundled snapshot preserves offline setup while refreshes handle provider server changes.
compatibility: Generated Gluetun services use qmcgaw/gluetun:latest as explicitly required and therefore intentionally follow that mutable upstream tag.
The generated /gluetun path uses a Docker-managed named volume to avoid host bind-directory ownership failures on first start.
Existing Gluetun data and manually maintained Compose files remain untouched; applying the generated add-on remains an operator action.
rollback: Disable online refresh and restore the prior static provider schema. Existing databases and user-managed Gluetun volumes are unchanged, but server choices may become stale.
